categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes RPC help text in src/rpc/net.cpp and fixes peer counter display formatting in bitcoin-cli via src/bitcoin-cli.cpp
categories.rationale: Fixes a minor display wraparound bug in bitcoin-cli -netinfo and clarifies RPC documentation. When manual connections exceed 255, the manual peer counter wraps or causes the column to disappear because it was typed as uint8_t instead of uint16_t.
